body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Tonium(www.tonium.com) showcased its potable DJ system device 'pacemaker' at the CES Unveiled, which comes with music player and mixer.
It supports more audio formats including MP3, M4A(AAC-LC), AIFF, FLAC, WAV, Ogg Vorbis and SND. The battery can operate up to 15 hours from fully charged. And it has a 60GB hard disk drive.
